name: AC deep cleaning
tagline: Jet and foam wash that restores cooling and airflow
summary: Thorough jet and foam cleaning of coils, fins, blower and drain tray.
description: A regular filter clean doesn't reach the dirt packed into the coil fins and blower wheel. Our deep cleaning uses a foam cleaner and pressure jet wash on the indoor and outdoor coils, cleans the blower and drain tray, and clears the drain line. It restores airflow, improves cooling and removes musty smells.
suitable_for: Split, window, cassette and tower ACs
includes: Foam and pressure jet wash of the indoor coil
Blower wheel and drain tray cleaning
Drain line flush and filter wash
Cooling and airflow check after cleaning
signs: Musty or damp smell when the AC runs
Weak airflow even with clean filters
Cooling has dropped since last summer
Black spots or dust on the vents

options.name: Cassette AC deep clean
options.detail: Panel, coil and drain pump cleaning

options.name: Multiple units
options.detail: Homes and offices with several ACs

process.title: Cover & protect
process.text: We cover the wall and furniture and fit a water-collection bag.

process.title: Foam wash
process.text: Coil cleaner foam loosens dust and grime in the fins.

process.title: Jet rinse
process.text: A pressure jet washes the coil, blower and drain tray.

process.title: Test
process.text: We check airflow, drainage and cooling after reassembly.

faqs.question: How often should I get a deep clean?
faqs.answer: Once a year before summer for homes. Dusty or high-use spaces benefit from twice a year.

faqs.question: Is the indoor unit removed from the wall?
faqs.answer: No. For split ACs we clean the indoor unit in place using a water-collection bag.
